Pattern library

Candlestick and chart patterns describe how price tends to behave in certain conditions. None of them proves a direction on its own; each points to a possibility.

At MarketLevelMap we read patterns together with support and resistance zones. Where a pattern forms matters as much as what it is: the same candle can mean something at a zone and little in open space.

  • Bullish Engulfing

    Yutan Boğa

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • 2 candles

    A reversal pattern that forms after a decline, when a large green candle completely engulfs the body of the previous red candle.

  • Head and Shoulders

    Omuz Baş Omuz (OBO)

    • Chart pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • Multi-candle

    A reversal pattern that forms at the end of an uptrend and is made of three peaks.
